items.rationale: The kitchen climate endorsement overrides the proximity exclusion in §2.3.10(c). The fixed 7.1 kW unit is a like-for-like replacement under §7.1.9; the gross line estimate is €1,413, with no stated deductible to apply.
The permanently fixed hallway unit is insured under §4.2.3 and was damaged by lightning overvoltage under §2.3.3. The gross estimate for one like-for-like 3.5 kW replacement under §7.1.9 is €1,413.
The study unit can be unplugged and moved without work on the building, so §4.3(d) excludes it. No amount is payable; €650 is a conditional estimate only.
Section 7.1.9(c) covers the labour to install, connect and commission the covered kitchen replacement. The reference rate is €479 gross for one installation.
Section 7.1.9(c) covers the labour to install, connect and commission the covered hallway replacement. The reference rate is €479 gross for one installation.
Under §§4.3(d) and 7.1.11, installation follows the excluded portable unit. No amount is payable; €479 is the conditional reference estimate.

Sections 7.1.9(e) and 7.1.12 cover ordinary pallet freight for the fixed replacements. Both units on the pallet are covered and the study unit travelled separately, so 100% of the estimated €125 gross standard freight is eligible under §7.1.11.

Section 7.1.12 excludes expedited delivery surcharges unless approved in advance or necessary to avert further loss; neither exception is indicated. No amount is payable; €50 is a conditional estimate only.
Section 7.1.13 excludes a separate charge for the same contractor's return visit unless agreed in advance, and no agreement is stated. No amount is payable; €82 is a conditional attendance estimate.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separately billed contractor administration as business overhead. No amount is payable; €35 is a conditional estimate only.
Section 5.2.1 excludes disposal of property that was not damaged by the insured event and was not removed for a covered replacement. No amount is payable; €90 is a conditional disposal estimate.
